name: comp-251
title: Dual Range With Output
blurb: Dual-range slider with numeric input fields beside each thumb.
description: A range slider paired with two input fields, allowing both drag and direct number entry for min and max.
use_when: Precise numeric range input with visual feedback.
avoid_when: Simple range selection; dual controls add visual complexity.
a11y: Input fields are keyboard accessible. Can use Tab to move between fields.
